In a world that often moves too fast, yoga offers a sacred pause—a moment to reconnect, breathe, and realign. But not all yoga experiences are created equal. While public classes offer community and rhythm, private yoga sessions unlock a deeper, more tailored path to transformation.

Private Yoga vs. Public Classes: What’s the Difference?

Group Size

  • Public Yoga Class: 10–30 participants
  • Private Yoga Session: 1-on-1 or small private group

Instructor Attention

  • Public Yoga Class: General guidance for all
  • Private Yoga Session: Personalized adjustments and feedback

Pace & Style

  • Public Yoga Class: Set by instructor for group flow
  • Private Yoga Session: Customized to your goals, energy, and level

Privacy & Comfort

  • Public Yoga Class: Shared space, varying energy
  • Private Yoga Session: Intimate setting, safe emotional space

Learning Curve

  • Public Yoga Class: Fast-paced, may feel overwhelming
  • Private Yoga Session: Gentle, supportive, beginner-friendly

Scheduling Flexibility

  • Public Yoga Class: Fixed class times
  • Private Yoga Session: Tailored to your calendar

Public classes are wonderful for social connection, rhythm, and structured flow. But if you’re a beginner or seeking deeper alignment—physically, emotionally, or spiritually—private yoga offers a sanctuary for growth and creates a safe space to learn, ask questions, and build confidence without pressure.

Why Choose Private Yoga and Why It is Ideal for Beginners?

  • Tailored Practice: Whether you're healing an injury, deepening your asana, or exploring energetic balance, private sessions meet you where you are.
  • Learn at Your Own Pace: No need to keep up with the group. You’ll receive step-by-step guidance tailored to your body and experience level.
  • Build Strong Foundations: Understand alignment, breathwork, and posture from the start—setting you up for a lifelong, injury-free practice.
  • Feel Safe and Seen: Private sessions allow you to express concerns, explore limitations, and grow in a space that honors your journey.
  • Holistic Integration: Sessions can weave in breathwork, meditation, gentle qigong movements, or sound therapy to cultivate energy flow and inner balance.
  • Accelerated Progress: With focused attention, you’ll refine posture, deepen breath, and embody presence more quickly than in group settings.

Bali Bliss Wellness: Your Private Yoga Sanctuary in Ubud

At Bali Bliss Wellness, we welcome beginners with open hearts and grounded expertise. Our private yoga sessions are held in semi-outdoor settings—where nature’s breeze and birdsong become part of your healing experience.

Whether you're new to movement or returning after a long pause, our facilitators guide you with compassion, clarity, and care. We offer:

  • Private yoga sessions designed for beginners and experienced practitioners.
  • Semi-outdoor spaces that blend comfort with nature.
  • Integration of breathwork, Qigong, and grounding tools like Koshi chimes and Tibetan bowls.
  • Custom packages for individuals, couples, or small groups.

Ready to Begin?

If you’ve been curious about yoga but unsure where to start, Bali Bliss Wellness is here to support you. Our private sessions are more than instruction—they’re an invitation to reconnect with your body, breath, and inner calm.

Book your beginner-friendly private yoga session today and take your first step into a practice that’s gentle, empowering, and uniquely yours.
